correctness.rationale: Tensor Laplacian diagonalization and an exact pair of eigenmode inequalities prove the sharp SLEM bound with equality; orbit-constant uniqueness follows from saturation. A positive-semidefinite averaged deficit forces every unrestricted optimizer to agree with the optimum on lifted Fiedler eigenfunctions. Local projected edge-vector independence then determines every individual edge transition and diagonal. Petersen local Gram identity equals (2/3)I_3; cycle neighbor differences have nonzero determinant. Exact sign calculation proves holding iff one Petersen factor. A standalone verifier passed 4,801 supporting assertions, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A structural, checkable local spectral criterion certifies uniqueness under all stochastic edge allocations, beyond merely finding a symmetric optimizer. On an infinite family of genuinely mixed Petersen-cycle products it yields explicit rates and a sharp, dimension-independent holding-vs-loopless transition at one versus at least two Petersen factors. This addresses an implementable and nontrivial equality-case gap in network mixing optimization.
